|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Scarif: Citadel Tower]] (version 1 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published (3 September 2021). The current text is [[Scarif: Citadel Tower (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-2021-09-03-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: If a player just Force drained here, they may raise a converted Scarif location to the top. Light: Unless your spy here, total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Scarif: Citadel Tower (Errata)]]): Card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-2022-06-01-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: If a player just Force drained here, they may raise a converted Scarif location to the top. Light: Unless your spy here, total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Scarif: Citadel Tower (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022<ref name="img-2022-06-11-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif</code> as published 11 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif holotable commit 6894629] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: If a player just Force drained here, they may raise a converted Scarif location to the top. Light: Unless your spy here, total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF at a larger size (745×534 → 1039×745 pixels) with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, which re-made 51 landscape card images that day; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name); it is the same card enlarged, with the same rounded transparent corners — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged. A visible (resolution) change, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Scarif: Citadel Tower (Errata 3)]]): Card image published 9 March 2026, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-2026-03-09-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif</code> as published 9 March 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif holotable commit 6f23e07] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: If Krennic or a Death Trooper here, Force drain +1 here. Light: If Cassian, Jyn, or K-2SO here, Force drain +1 here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Light Side text “Unless your spy here, total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.” became “If Cassian, Jyn, or K-2SO here, Force drain +1 here.”. Dark Side text “If a player just Force drained here, they may raise a converted Scarif location to the top.” became “If Krennic or a Death Trooper here, Force drain +1 here.”.
